walkthrough: Goal: a beginner who took the first lesson practises along the path for a day: a skill's lesson judged by eye, the next one in place on the same sheet, a review of what came out Again, a lesson the app judges, a dot earned, the day's work in the practice book; the next day's lesson on a sheet of its own.

Entry: Home after the first lesson (started here by a lesson step) and half an hour away. All units: the path page. Its head is Home, Practice and the eight units' rings on a dashed road, unit 1 ringed in ink, 2 to 5 quieter with their names, 6 to 8 bare rings that never open. Unit 1 · Lines and colours: the Lines, Combined lines and Colours tiles, each a small drawing, its name and three empty dots; beside them the next lesson (Lines, Beginning, 6 exercises, about 5 min, Start) and to practise longer the unit's full lesson with its minutes. Practice book at the foot, the First step seal beside it.

Tap Lines: the day's sheet opens on its second row, labelled Lesson 2 · Lines, the first lesson's row above it; the bar says Lines 1/6, How, Compare, Next; the line's How shows by itself; Got it. I copy the line and tap Compare: the original lies over mine in red and the card asks How close is it? with Accurate, Almost, Again and a quiet line that nothing is scored, Again brings it back later. Accurate: it is ringed and stays chosen. Next: Almost on the second, Again on the third, Next without a tap on the fourth (no result, nothing asks for one), Accurate on the fifth and sixth; the last action is Finish.

Finish: the end. The view settles on the rows used, each pair's result as a small mark under it (a dot, a half ring, an empty ring; none under the one not judged). The card: Lines, 6 exercises and the time; the six results in a row (the unjudged one a pencil ring); Lines' three dots, still empty, right under the rule; One more, under it what it starts: Combined lines · 3 exercises · about 6 min, on the next row of this sheet; That's all for today.

One more: the next lesson is laid in place on the same sheet from a new row, Lesson 3 · Combined lines; the view glides down to its first pair, the Lines rows above it with their marks still there. Its How first; Got it. Undo after a line takes back only that line: the history ends at the exercise shown. Next, Next, Finish without drawing: nothing marked.

That's all for today: the home. Next lesson Colours (never practised); under a rule Review on the side: Lines · 2 exercises, Review, and Again last time (a redo waits). Review: Lesson 4 · Lines on the sheet, the bar Lines 1/2, its first exercise the line that came out Again; both Accurate, Finish; the redo is answered.

A lesson the app judges: All units, Unit 2 (Single shapes and Colour combinations greyed, Needs a practice pack / Needs a pack of colour crops: tapped, they start nothing and the page stays; the others to tap), Unit 3, Estimates: Lesson 5 · Estimates, Place a point's How; Got it. I mark the point where the original's is and Compare: the app's verdict, Accurate ringed, nothing to tap. The second I mark far off: Again ringed, the answer's cross in red and Construction to show how it is found. Next to the end, Finish: the end's row says Accurate, Again and four not judged.

A dot: All units, Lines, six lines each judged Accurate, Finish. The window of the last six judged lines is all Accurate, so the end says Up to “Beginning” over Lines' dots, the first inked in. That's all for today; All units: the Lines tile shows one dot; the next lesson stays Colours by the rule (fewest dots first), the review now Estimates.

The practice book (from the path's foot): October, today ringed; tap Monday 5 October: today's card, its time and one picture, the whole sheet cropped to the rows used, named by its lessons: Lesson 1 · First lesson, Lesson 2 · Lines, … Lesson 6 · Lines.

A lesson left open: Home, Start opens Colours on the next row (its How), Home again: the home says Today's lesson, under way: Colours 1/3, and Continue. The app is closed and started again: Home shows the same, the path as left (Lines one dot). Continue opens Colours on the same sheet at its first pair; Next to its end, That's all for today.
The next day (the app left overnight): Start: today's sheet is a new one, its first row Lesson 8 · Combined lines (the rule moves on: Colours was practised); yesterday's sheet stays as it was.

Cancel: Home on the sheet at any point leaves for the home, the lesson kept under way; Back from the path and the book is Home. Failure: a lesson that does not fit the rows left takes a new sheet (the app's tests).

shown: Lesson 1 · First lesson, Lesson 2 · Lines, Lesson 3 · Combined lines, Lesson 4 · Lines, Lesson 5 · Estimates, Lesson 6 · Lines
